verses.1: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment: to thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.2: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.3: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.4: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person .
verses.5: Whoever privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I cut off: him that hath a high look and a proud heart I will not suffer.
verses.6: My eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.7: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.8: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all who practice wickedness from the city of the LORD.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), simplified for children aged 8-12. Faithful to the KJV tradition.
